project_info.theme: faithful restoration of an attached archival portrait
project_info.color_palette: source-faithful warm neutrals and original garment colors

main_subject.type: person shown in the attached archival photograph
main_subject.detail: Preserve only the visible identity, age presentation, face, hairstyle, clothing, seated pose, and backdrop in the attached source image.
main_subject.style: natural high-detail restoration, never a new portrait generation

composition_elements.text: Preserve source text only if present; do not add or alter text.
items: match original crop, framing, seated pose, wardrobe, and environment
repair fading, stains, scratches, blur, and damaged paper areas conservatively
retain archival texture and historical character

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: recover balanced exposure and detail without changing direction, era, or mood

technical_specs.render_style: non-generative high-resolution restoration comparable to Canon EOS R6 Mark II clarity, exact face preservation, restrained denoise, no beauty retouching
technical_specs.resolution: highest recoverable detail at the original aspect ratio

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Restore the attached old portrait into a natural professional DSLR-quality image. Preserve the exact face, identity, age presentation, expression, hairstyle, clothing, seated pose, crop, background, and historical character shown in the source. Repair scratches, fading, stains, noise, blur, and damaged paper areas conservatively. Improve recoverable clarity, tonal balance, and natural color to a level comparable to a Canon EOS R6 Mark II portrait while retaining realistic skin texture and archival character. Do not add or remove people, alter the face or age, change clothing, invent missing detail, replace the background, or modernize the scene beyond faithful restoration.
prompt.negative_prompt: identity change, face swap, age alteration, added person, removed person, invented clothing, invented background, changed pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, text alteration, deformed

assets.name: source-archival-portrait
assets.source: Attach the original old portrait photograph.
assets.usage: Mandatory preservation source for identity, age presentation, face, clothes, pose, and environment.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The original archival portrait is mandatory. Apply only conservative restoration and preserve uncertainty in unrecoverable damaged areas rather than inventing details.
